entry.summary: Since 2016 travel from mainland Australia to Norfolk Island is domestic. Australian citizens need photo ID (such as a driver's licence), not a passport, though operators still recommend one.
entry.other: New Zealand and other foreign citizens need a passport and must meet mainland Australian entry rules, including any visa. Flights still use international terminals.
entry.next_check: Read the Australian Government's Norfolk Island travel information page (timed out on 31 October 2026).
